summary_md: **miqu | Building in public ([@HUNTER_z1389](https://x.com/HUNTER_z1389/status/2114976616736567768))** points to **Hob** (FrigadeHQ), a free MIT-licensed desktop app for running open-weight models such as Gemma and gpt-oss locally on Mac, Windows and Linux; it works offline and picks a model that fits the machine.
